types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker, 1P, 20 A, B curve, bare device

document.title: Електроразпределение ниско напрежение (Low-voltage electrical distribution), Merlin Gerin / Schneider Electric
document.revision: Undated historical Bulgarian catalog; no revision identified

modelingNotes: Exact order 24052 is in the C60N, B-curve, 1P, 20 A row, printed p.56; adjacent 1P schematic explicitly labels terminals 1 and 2. No terminal aliases.
20 A nominal current at 30 deg C; B-curve magnetic trip 3-5 times In (printed p.55). Current metadata is device rating, not conductor ampacity.

Printed p.55 gives C60N 1P IEC 60947-2 Icu: 20 kA at 130 V, 10 kA at 240 V, 3 kA at 415 V; the last value is for one pole in an IT system under double-fault conditions. No scalar breaking-capacity or assigned nominal-voltage field is used.

Korean manufacturer guide, pp.42-43, corroborates exact identity and separately lists C60N 6-63 A DC capability: 15 kA at less than 60 V with one pole, magnetic uprating coefficient 1.38. Its general 250 V DC headline applies across pole arrangements, not to this single-pole order. Source: https://www.eocrsek.co.kr/datafiles/schneider/guide_060727.pdf

Two tunnel terminals form one interruptible protection pole. Contact metadata and the breaker symbol do not join nets. normal_state open depicts the catalog OFF/open schematic, not an asserted installed state or trip simulation.

Bare breaker only. Auxiliary switches, releases, Vigi modules and external comb busbars are separate additions (printed p.54); no accessory terminals or permanent links are included. Connections are application-dependent, hence neither terminal is universally required.

Bulgarian p.55 specifies up-to-25 A terminals for 16 mm2 flexible or 25 mm2 rigid conductor; Korean p.42 gives a generic 35 mm2 below 63 A. This presentation difference is not resolved into automated conductor limits. Voltage type is omitted because AC and DC capability are documented.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare order 24052: the applicable 1P circuit diagram inventories two main electrical connections, 1 and 2. No separate neutral, PE, shield, signal or communication connection is part of this bare breaker; optional added modules are outside this order.

1.description: Main pole terminal 1 (upper in manufacturer schematic)

2.description: Main pole terminal 2 (lower in manufacturer schematic)
